newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Intel, Advanced Micro.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Intel, Advanced Micro.

text.p: SoundView Financial Group said analyst Scott Randall downgraded Intel Corp to short-term hold from buy, keeping a long-term buy rating on the stock.
-- lowered his fiscal 1997 earnings estimate to $7.96 from $8.47 and fiscal 1998 to $10.10 from $10.75.
-- cut Advanced Micro Devices Inc to short-term hold from buy, keeping a long-term hold on the stock.
-- reduced fiscal 1997 estimate to $1.41 from $1.53 and fiscal 1998 to $3.42 from $3.80.
-- Intel was up 3/32 to 143-3/4. Advanced Micro fell one to 37.
